say:1:1122513001:1.text: Another group of punks? The law and order in Alkali stinks as much as terrabird scat.
say:1:1122513001:1.source_cn: 又是一群作恶之人？咸水镇的治安，果然不是一时半刻就能好...

say:2:1122513002:1.text: Hey, don't look at me like that. Ever since I fought you, I've behaved. I mean, I'm not afraid of you or anything.
say:2:1122513002:1.source_cn: 别这样看着我。自打与你一战之后，我就改邪归正了——当然...
say:2:1122513002:1.male: Hey, don't look at me like that. Ever since I fought you, I've behaved. I mean, I'm not afraid of you or anything.
say:2:1122513002:1.female: Hey, don't look at me like that. Ever since I fought you, I've behaved. I mean, I'm not afraid of you or anything.

say:3:1122513003:1.text: Thanks to you, the town is right as rain.
say:3:1122513003:1.source_cn: 这回多亏了你，镇上才没出大乱子。
say:3:1122513003:1.male: Thanks to you, the town is right as rain.
say:3:1122513003:1.female: Thanks to you, the town is right as rain.
